To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the overall performance of the system is strongly dependent on the block matching algorithm, the performance of the motion estimation algorithms is dependent on the frame rate, the frame size, the motion vector range, the motion vector precision and the search window size.
the performance of the block matching motion estimation algorithm is dependent on the block matching search pattern, the search window, and the motion vector precision.
the performance of the three motion estimation algorithms are comparable and they are all able to provide the best performance in terms of PSNR.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the performance evaluation of three block matching algorithms, namely, the full search (FS), three step search (TSS) and the diamond search (DS) algorithms.
the performance of different motion estimation algorithms in the context of video coding system.
the performance analysis of three motion estimation algorithms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the performance of block matching motion estimation depends on the video sequence, the motion characteristics of the sequence, the motion vector search range and the motion estimation algorithm.
the block matching algorithm is an efficient motion estimation algorithm.
the overall performance of the motion estimation algorithms depends on the video coding algorithm and the video sequence.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we implemented three different algorithms in a wavelet-based video coding system.
, the block matching motion estimation algorithm has an impact on video coding performance, but not significant.
we are able to predict the performance of the system in a high-level design and to compare the performance of the different block matching algorithms.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the choice of motion estimation algorithm is a critical design decision that can affect the system performance.
, in order to make a better design choice, a system level evaluation is necessary.
a high-level implementation of video coding systems can be used as a design exploration tool to predict system performance before the chip design and circuit layout process is deployed.
